caption:
Back on the reformer after the break and feeling a bit rusty, like Momo? Totally normal.

A few weeks of summer holidays rarely undo your progress. Strength and control usually come back faster than they took to build. For the first week or two, drop a spring or a few reps, start with foundations like footwork and bridging, and finish each class with a little left in the tank.

Mild soreness after your first class back is common and usually settles within a few days. Picked up a new niggle? Tell your instructor so your program can be adjusted.

Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can plan your first few weeks back. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
